title: Developing a car-fleet analysis
text: One woonbase population RDW fleet per year, keeping active passenger cars. RDWNPACT also holds dropped business-stock vehicles, filter code active passenger cars, word “personenauto”. StatLine tables used: 85237NED (fuel, construction year, weight), 85236NED (vehicles region), 85404NED (kilometres), 37230ned (population).
code: YEARS <- 2019:2025  simulate_year <- function(year) {   sim_reset()   woonbase_init(year = year, n = 20000L, seed = 42L)   sim_init("rdw", year = year, seed = 43L)    pers <- as.data.table(read_sav(sprintf("WoonbasePopulatiePersonen%dV1", year),                                  col_select = c(RINPERSOON, GemeenteCodeJJJJ1Jan)))   kent <- as.data.table(read_sav(sprintf("RDWNPACT%dTABV1", year),     col_select = c(RINPERSOON, RINKENTEKEN, VRTGSOORT, BRANDSTCODECORVRTG,                    EERSTETOELDAT1VRTG, MASSALEEGCORVRTG)))   vp <- as.data.table(read_sav(sprintf("VERKEERSPRESTATIE%dTABV1", year),                                col_select = c(RINKENTEKEN, VPJAARKM, VPGEWICHT)))    kent[vp, on = "RINKENTEKEN", `:=`(jaarkm = as.numeric(i.VPJAARKM),                                     vpgewicht = as.numeric(i.VPGEWICHT))]   kent[, `:=`(year = year, n_pers = nrow(pers),               bouwjaar = as.integer(EERSTETOELDAT1VRTG),               gewicht = as.numeric(MASSALEEGCORVRTG),               fuelcode = as.character(cbs_code(BRANDSTCODECORVRTG)))]   kent[cbs_code(VRTGSOORT) == "6"]  # personenauto, actief park } cars <- rbindlist(lapply(YEARS, simulate_year))  # StatLine reports hybrids under petrol, so PHEV (A) and HEV (B) join petrol cars[, brandstof := fcase(fuelcode %in% c("1", "A", "B"), "benzine",                           fuelcode == "2", "diesel", fuelcode == "3", "lpg",                           fuelcode == "4", "elektrisch", default = "overig")]

title: simregdata 0.4.0
text: Documentation moved pkgdown site; README getting-started vignette shortened. Worked examples (cars, household income, energy use) develop analysis code simulated data, compare StatLine list differs Remote Access. Dwelling characteristics (municipality, build year, floor area) stable across years. Energy use depends dwelling type, floor area, build year household size, calibrated StatLine 81528NED 85140NED. Household income (INHATAB) calibrated per household type 83932NED. VEHTAB household keys now match INPATAB INHATAB. Cross-dataset join checks moved test suite.
